title: Node pool access intake & capacity tracker (Q2 intake)
content:
Purpose: lightweight intake tracker for node-pool/GPU requests that require dedicated nodes or larger burst allocations. Use this sheet to triage, assign owners, and surface approvals.

Intake SLAs:
- Initial acknowledgement: 2 business days
- Capacity decision: 7 business days (unless dependent on HW procurement)
- Provisioning target for approved requests: 5 business days (shared burst), 15 business days (dedicated node pools)

How to use:
1) Fill a new row when a team requests GPUs for experiments, launches, or sustained workloads.
2) Include linked ticket(s) and attach perf/latency/cost justification.
3) Eng-infra triage meets Tue/Thu to prioritize: capacity_owner assigns staging pool or schedule.
4) Approval: infra leads + security if private/VPC required.

Allocation guidance notes:
- Preferred fill order: spare shared-burst -> regional staging pools -> dedicated node pools (requires 2-week lead and manager approval).
- If request crosses regions, prefer colocated shared pools unless private deployment is required.
- For P0 requests flagged as "launch blocking" escalate to infra pager and tag with @oncall.

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Confirm EU H100 availability week-of-2026-04-01 (procurement has tentative ETA).
- Define SLA for ephemeral preemptible allocations for research teams.

Owner contact: priya.nair@redwood.ai
